headlines.description: The only known handwritten draft of The Reverend Martin Luther King Jr.'s 'I Have a Dream' speech is on display in his hometown. The iconic phrase, however, never made it on the page.

sources.title: MLK's handwritten draft of iconic speech on display for the first time
sources.description: ATLANTA – The only known draft of one of the most famous speeches in American history is on public display for the first time: The Reverend Martin Luther King Jr.’s remarks at the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom in 1963. And it’s written in his own hand.
